The Gazing Sage]]'' }} |} The '''Ball Guy''' (Japanese: '''ボールガイ''' ''Ball Guy'') is a character introduced in {{g|Sword and Shield}}. ==In the core series games== The Ball Guy is the mascot of the [[Galar]] [[Galar League|Pokémon League]]. Over the course of their [[Gym]] Challenge, the {{player}} will meet a person dressed in a Ball Guy mascot costume in or near each Stadium Lobby, who will give them a variety [[Poké Ball]] with each meeting. It is later revealed that the person dressed as the Ball Guy is not sanctioned by the Pokémon League and has been acting of their own volition. Their true identity is unknown. The player can receive the Ball Guy's [[League Card]] outside of Motostoke Stadium after they become {{pkmn|Champion}}. The Ball Guy mascot will also reward the player after they defend their title or win the [[Galarian Star Tournament]] in [[Wyndon Stadium]]. [[File:Company PhoneCase Ball Guy.png|thumb|75px|Ball Guy case for the Rotom Phone]] In [[Pokémon Scarlet and Violet]], if the player has [[Save data bonus|save data]] from Pokémon Sword or Shield, a woman in [[Mesagoza]] will give them a [[Rotom Phone]] case modeled after the Ball Guy. Additionally, starting in version 3.0.0, once the player has tutored the [[Team Star]] Bosses, [[Atticus]] can sell the player a helmet designed after the Ball Guy at [[Porto Marinada]]. ===League Card=== This is a transcript of the back of the Ball Guy's [[League Card]] in [[Pokémon Sword and Shield]]. :"This mysterious figure has taken it upon himself (herself?) to dress up in the fashion of the [[Galar League|Pokémon League]]'s official mascot. The mysterious individual is known to many as "the Ball Guy" but in point of fact, all are mystified when it comes to this person's true identity or age or even gender. While the Ball Guy is known for her (his?) habit of handing out rare [[Poké Ball]]s here and there around Galar, it's a mystery as to why or even where these balls come from. In ''[[TW08|The Gathering of Stars]]'', the Ball Guy was seen outside [[Wyndon Stadium]]. ===Pokémon Evolutions=== The Ball Guy appeared in ''[[PE01|The Champion]]'', dancing at the [[Wyndon Stadium]] before the start of {{ga|Victor}} and [[Leon]]'s [[Galar League|Championship Match]]. {{-}} ==In the manga== [[File:Ball Guy Adventures.png|thumb|150px|Casey's Ball Guy mask in Pokémon Adventures]] ===Pokémon Adventures=== ===={{MangaArc|Sword & Shield}}==== {{Casey}} is a fan of the Ball Guy. She owns a Ball Guy mask and was first seen using it to scare [[Marvin]] in ''[[PASS01|Wow!! That's One Big Pokémon]]''. The actual Ball Guy was first seen in ''[[PASS12|Thump!! The Gazing Sage]]'' at the [[Motostoke Stadium]]. They were seen reacting in pain when [[Kabu]] loudly congratulated Casey and [[Hop]] for beating the first three Galar [[Gym]]s. They were then seen again in ''[[PASS16|Rising!! Opal of Ballonlea]]'' at the [[Ballonlea Stadium]], bringing dry towels to Henry and Marvin after they got wet during their earlier training. {{-}} ==In the TCG== [[File:BallGuyShiningFates65.jpg|200px|thumb|Full Art print of the Ball Guy]] {{main|Ball Guy (Shining Fates 57)}} The '''Ball Guy''' was introduced as a {{TCG|Supporter card}} in the [[Pokémon Trading Card Game]] during the English Sword & Shield Series (the Japanese Sword & Shield Era). It was first released in the Japanese {{TCG|Shiny Star V}} expansion before debuting in English in the {{TCG|Shining Fates}} expansion, with artwork by [[Hitoshi Ariga]]. It was also released as a {{TCG|Full Art card}} in the same Japanese and English expansions, with artwork by the same artist. It allows the player to search their deck for up to three {{TCG|Item card}}s with the word "Ball" in their name, put them in their hand, then shuffle their deck. {{-}} ==Trivia== *The Ball Guy's gender is consistently left ambiguous in the games, strategy guide, and official websites.''"It's hard to miss the Ball Guy when you enter the stadium.
